actions.entry_point: Settings → Setup → CPU budget, or an explicit Butler request to configure this Core host
actions.core_owner: Host-local enabled policy, Core-owned PDF worker lifecycle and observed Linux CPU affinity
actions.authority: Explicit host CPU budget request; enabling/disabling additionally requires an explicit activation request. Use fresh host_id/expected_revision and enabled only when requested; omission preserves state. Core persists and reads back policy. Running requires observed live workers/affinity with executor_state=running and apply_state=applied; disabled requires zero workers. Resize/disable drains accepted PDF work.
actions.observed_result_test: tests/v3/test_report_cpu_activation.py::test_butler_activates_and_reads_actual_running_then_disabled_workers
actions.result: One PDF worker pool shared across this host’s projects. Saving, starting, draining, running, failure and disabled states have distinct observed receipts; other hosts and external chat/tool/LLM/GPU execution are separate.
